requirements.text: Online tools for students to manage loans, including searching for items, checking availability, borrowing, returning, renewing items, and booking study rooms.
Prevent students from making new loans or booking rooms if they have outstanding fines.
Automate the fine calculation process while maintaining personal interaction for edge cases and exceptions.
Reports for librarians on loan volumes, popular items, and study room usage.
The system should be straightforward for students to use.
Manage edge cases and exceptions carefully in the fine calculation process.
